items.title: A Halloween costume of Lois Griffin falling down the stairs
items.summary: For Halloween, @blonddtyler put on an orange wig, a teal shirt and khakis and was photographed mid-air on a staircase, posted next to the Family Guy frame of Lois tumbling down the stairs, captioned "howd i do?" (208K likes). The Lois frame has been a reaction image since 2019, and the full-body commitment to the fall is what people shared; the top quote-post, "do you wanna do this or not", drew another 161K. It outran the celebrity costumes of the night, including Heidi Klum dressed as a giant severed replica of her own hand (Variety's video, 66K).
items.author: @blonddtyler
